instruction: Locate the cell with the maximum value in the Parameter column and highlight it using any background color.

metadata.explanation: Task requires finding the maximum Parameter value and highlighting it. Evaluator dynamically finds the cell with maximum value in column A at runtime, then verifies that cell is highlighted with a background color.

llm_judge_reasons: COMPLETE COVERAGE: Evaluator verifies both requirements - (1) finding the maximum value in Parameter column, (2) highlighting that specific cell
DYNAMIC VERIFICATION: Getter dynamically scans all rows in column A at runtime to find the actual maximum value (not hardcoded to A8)
CORRECT LOGIC: Getter finds max value cell wherever it is, then checks if THAT specific cell is highlighted - correctly detects wrong cell highlighting
ROBUST IMPLEMENTATION: Getter handles numeric conversion with try/except, skips non-numeric values, scans entire column (rows 1 to max_row)
CORRECT PARAMETER HANDLING: Metric correctly accesses expected.get('is_highlighted') directly without the wrong .get('rules') pattern
APPROPRIATE FLEXIBILITY: Accepts any background color (not specific color), which matches instruction 'any background color'
PROPER STATE MANAGEMENT: Postconfig saves file with Ctrl+S to persist highlighting state for verification
CORRECT HIGHLIGHTING DETECTION: Properly excludes default colors (00000000, FFFFFFFF) to detect actual user highlighting
